description: Running WinUI app: the user wants to mark visual problems on the elements themselves and have an agent pick the notes up and fix the XAML.
prompt: I want to click around Lanternfish myself and point at the spots that look off (spacing, wording, a couple of colors), with each note pinned to the thing I clicked. Afterwards you pick them up and fix the XAML. How do we set that up, and how will you read them back?
